page.overview:
Who is Celdria?

was a blue female dragonborn child held (with her mother Celeste and brother Celwyn) in Rybad-Kol prison as of the final battle of the Calamity. As an NPC, was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Celdria was wide-eyed and expectant while in the caravan of dragonborn being sent to The Scaled Tyrant, in contrast to her brother who was withdrawn and vacant.

Celdria, her mother, and her brother were part of a caravan of dragonborn being assembled at the prison to be sent to The Scaled Tyrant, either to fight on the front lines or to be eaten by her. They happened to be seated next to Crokas and Erro Mordaurum, and when Rei'nia Saph arrived with a convincing story that Crokas was contagious, they were part of the group taken to the prison's oubliette in order to minimize the risk of illness being spread. Thus, they survived the battle between the Strife Emperor and the Prime Deities that took place above them, and termed the damage it caused, "Nuts!" They were part of the group of twelve that began the trek northward in its aftermath. The two children in the party suffered from exhaustion and dehydration along with the others, and after several days, Crokas took them on his back and began walking on all fours, like a monitor lizard, carrying them. When The Stormlord's rain began falling, the children opened their mouths to suck in the life-restoring water, and they were part of the group that witnessed the Stormlord's farewell and gift of Stormgirdle to Crokas.

Celdria reached Torm's Hill with the rest of the party, and was present when soldiers of the Strife Emperor arrived and were bloodily defeated. Seeing Crokas still lost in battle frenzy afterwards, Celdria and her brother approached and embraced him, telling him, "You don't have to be scared."
